svg.text: Three-node Raft HA: import database replicates data to every peer via TX_ENTRY

g.text: stage the fixture on EVERY node
stage the fixture on EVERY node
await the DB on every node
await the DB on every node
the fixture must exist on all peers:
The importer reads the archive from the local disk of whichever node leads - and that is not deterministic.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Import is a leader-only write, so it is sent to the elected leader instead of relying on HTTP forwarding.
The imported database must appear in each node's database list before any query is attempted.
Each node gets its own RemoteDatabase with a FIXED strategy, so the client never follows an internal Docker address.
until(select count(*) as cnt from Person -> cnt > 0) atMost 60s per node
Node 0's count is the reference; the other two must match it exactly.
